content:
Platforms: Windows, Public Cloud
This event provides key metadata regarding security groups in AWS. CrowdStrike retrieves this information by processing the response from AWS's
DescribeSecurityGroups API [https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeSecurityGroups.html] on your behalf.
Security groups control the level of network based access to resources within a VPC and can typically associated to network interfaces and their attached EC2
instances.
This event is only generated for Discover for AWS [/support/documentation/10/falcon-discover-feature-guide] customers. It's generated either when Discover
for AWS observes new or related activity via CloudTrail or during Discover for AWS's weekly full scan.
